name: ZBP Enterprise Policy Pack
description: Zscaler Best Practice (ZBP) enterprise DLP policy pack: US PII, US PHI, financial information, ITAR, Traffic Light Protocol markings and private keys, as monitor-only web DLP rules with their dictionaries and engines. Immutable: objects that drift from this definition are restored on the next deploy. All rules ship DISABLED at INFO severity (Zscaler's delivery convention): review, tune, then enable each rule and raise its severity.
deploy_note: Install one channel at a time. Deploy Web DLP first, check it, then Endpoint DLP, then SaaS, then Email, one channel per run. A small run is easy to verify and avoids the burst of requests that makes ZIA block the API client (Resource Access Blocked).
source: mkoyfman/zbp-automation zbp-enterprise-zia (Zscaler Best Practice enterprise pack)
audience: Any commercial enterprise. Zscaler's recommended starting point for US PII, US PHI, financial data, ITAR, TLP markings and private keys.
when_to_use: The customer has no DLP policy yet, or wants Zscaler's best-practice monitoring rules as an immutable policy pack. Start here unless a regulation-specific pack applies.
